description: Necessary condition sum_{c in C_S} q_c <= A_S per room set S of the physical rooms U (capacity thresholds, single rooms, and the max-deficit set over all subsets via min-cut). A failing S certifies that no room-feasible schedule exists; passing is not a proof of feasibility.

conventions.admissible_rooms: ProblemInstance.possible_rooms after _apply_RU3_capacity_filter (capacity >= C_quantities[c]); the code has no room-type filter
conventions.q_c: ceil(required minutes / max didactic minutes of slots with 0 < length <= required); lecturer availability ignored
conventions.room_universe_U: R_fizycznie_istniejace minus remote rooms (R_zdalne); a course that may use a room outside U never enters C_S
conventions.excluded: remote courses (C_zdalne); courses with q_c = 0 contribute nothing
